description: This PHP script is a test module for integrating with Kaiten issue tracker. It creates an instance of kaitenrestInterface, checks connectivity, adds a new issue, and retrieves issue details, primarily for testing the API interaction.

classes.name: kaitenrestInterface
classes.description: Class responsible for interfacing with Kaiten issue tracker API, including methods to connect, add issues, and retrieve issue details.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection to Kaiten server is active.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Kaiten with provided summary and description.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific issue by ID from Kaiten.
